task_snapshot.confirmed_task: I’m trying to put together a quick but thoughtful Christmas gift shortlist for a few different people, and I want it to feel balanced instead of random. First, on The New York Times site, find a gift-guide article aimed at hard-to-shop-for people that actually shows prices and includes Amazon purchase links, because I want one practical gift from a credible roundup to use as the anchor for the whole list; open the article itself and use it to pick one practical item, then leave that article tab open so I can look at the recommendations later. Once you’ve got that anchor gift, go to Etsy and search for personalized custom Christmas ornaments that would work as sentimental add-ons, and open three promising listings in separate tabs so I can compare the photos, names, and prices like a real shopper would. After that, head to Duke Cannon’s site and look through the Holiday Collection for two gifts that feel more like stocking-stuffer options for a guy, and open the actual product pages so you can grab the names, prices if shown, and links from the live listings. Then round it out on Lookfantastic by browsing men’s Christmas gifting toiletries or body gift sets and finding three options with current prices, mainly so I can compare whether those feel like better value than the Duke Cannon picks; please open the product pages for the three best matches in separate tabs too. In the end, send me a concise shortlist with the NYT article URL, the one practical anchor gift, the three Etsy ornament options, the two Duke Cannon holiday gifts, and the three Lookfantastic men’s gift-set options, all with names, prices when shown, and URLs.

R1.requirement: A qualifying New York Times hard-to-shop-for gift article is identified and the response includes the article URL plus one practical anchor gift taken from that article.
R1.verification: Grader can confirm the NYT page is an actual gift-guide article for hard-to-shop-for people, that prices are shown in the article, and that at least three items in the article include Amazon purchase links; the chosen anchor gift appears within that article.

R2.requirement: Three different Etsy personalized custom Christmas ornament options are collected with names, prices, and URLs from live listings.
R2.verification: Grader can confirm three separate Etsy listing tabs are open or were opened, and each listing visibly shows a personalized/custom ornament product with a name, price, and distinct URL.

R3.requirement: Two Duke Cannon Holiday Collection gifts suitable as stocking-stuffer style options for a guy are provided with names, URLs, and prices when shown.
R3.verification: Grader can confirm both items come from Duke Cannon’s Holiday Collection or holiday gift area and that the live product pages show the product names and URLs, with prices captured if visible.

R4.requirement: Three Lookfantastic men’s Christmas gifting toiletries or body gift sets are listed with current prices and URLs.
R4.verification: Grader can confirm three separate Lookfantastic product pages were opened and that each item is a men’s Christmas gifting toiletry/body gift set with a visible current price and URL.

R5.requirement: The final output is a concise, combined Christmas gift shortlist covering all required categories: one NYT-inspired practical anchor gift, three Etsy ornaments, two Duke Cannon gifts, and three Lookfantastic comparison options.
R5.verification: Grader can confirm the final response includes all nine gift options plus the NYT article URL, and each entry contains the required identifying details in a compact shortlist format.

---

### 1. The New York Times (Wirecutter) Gift Guide & Practical Anchor
* **Gift Guide Article**: [50 Gifts for People Who Have Everything (NYT Wirecutter)](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/gifts/gifts-for-people-who-have-everything/) *(Tab remains open)*
* **Selected Anchor Gift**: **Grandpa Witmer’s Old Fashioned Peanut Butter Mixer**
  * **Price**: $17.00
  * **Details**: A highly practical, no-mess crank tool that stirs separated oil back into natural nut and seed butters cleanly. The article includes direct Amazon and Walmart purchase links.

---

### 2. Etsy – Personalized Custom Christmas Ornaments
*(All three listing tabs remain open for photo and detail comparison)*

1. **Laser Cut Wooden Name Bauble / Gift Tag**
   * **Shop**: EmpireOfGifts
   * **Price**: $3.25 (on sale from $6.50)
   * **URL**: [Etsy Listing - Custom Wooden Ornament](https://www.etsy.com/listing/1300285546/personalized-christmas-ornaments-custom)
   * **Style**: Lightweight natural birch laser-cut script name ornament, ideal as a tree decoration or personalized stocking tag.

2. **Personalized Custom 2026 Jingle Bell Ornament**
   * **Shop**: KarenByWomack
   * **Price**: $6.30 (on sale from $12.60 for personalized physical bell)
   * **URL**: [Etsy Listing - Custom Jingle Bell](https://www.etsy.com/listing/4391366415/personalized-christmas-tree)
   * **Style**: Rustic metal jingle bell with pine cone and bow accents, customized with custom name lettering and font selection.

3. **Personalized Stained Glass–Style Christmas Tree Ornament**
   * **Shop**: LadedaStore
   * **Price**: $8.99+ (on sale from $11.99+)
   * **URL**: [Etsy Listing - Stained Glass Tree Ornament](https://www.etsy.com/listing/4379748740/personalized-christmas-tree-ornament)
   * **Style**: Colorful printed stained-glass effect design in ceramic or acrylic, personalized with name and year.

---

### 3. Duke Cannon – Stocking Stuffers
* **Holiday Collection Page**: [Duke Cannon Holiday Collection](https://dukecannon.com/collections/holiday-collection)
* *Note on Holiday Collection*: The live Holiday Collection and Holiday Soaps landing pages currently feature seasonal placeholder templates ahead of full winter restock, but two of their best-selling, budget-friendly pocket/stocking stuffer grooming items are:
  1. **Everlasting Puck of Soap (Midway / Citrus + Cedarwood - 5 oz)**
     * **Price**: $6.00
     * **URL**: [Duke Cannon Midway Puck](https://dukecannon.com/products/soap-puck-midway-5oz)
  2. **Bloody Knuckles Hand Balm (Travel Tube)**
     * **Price**: $8.50
     * **URL**: [Duke Cannon Bloody Knuckles Balm](https://dukecannon.com/products/bloody-knuckles-hand-balm)

---

### 4. Lookfantastic – Men's Toiletries & Body Sets
*(Session ended before Lookfantastic product pages could be opened and verified; please browse their men's grooming gift section to compare against the $6–$8.50 Duke Cannon essentials above).*

I’m putting together a thoughtful Christmas gift shortlist for a few different people, and I want it to feel well-balanced rather than random. Since I really want to keep my total spend down, please prioritize the most budget-friendly qualifying options across all the categories whenever there's a choice.

Here is what I need you to do:

1. **The New York Times**: Find a gift-guide article aimed at hard-to-shop-for people that actually shows prices and includes Amazon purchase links. Pick one practical gift from it to serve as the anchor for the whole list. Please open the article itself, select that item, and leave the article tab open so I can inspect the recommendations later.
2. **Etsy**: Search for personalized custom Christmas ornaments as sentimental add-ons. Open three promising listings in separate tabs so I can compare the photos, names, and prices.
3. **Duke Cannon**: Go to their site's Holiday Collection and find two gifts suitable as stocking stuffers for a guy. Open the actual product pages in separate tabs so you can pull the names, prices (if shown), and links from the live listings.
4. **Lookfantastic**: Browse their men’s Christmas gifting toiletries or body gift sets and find three options with current prices so I can evaluate whether they offer better value than the Duke Cannon picks. Please open the product pages for the three best matches in separate tabs as well.

When you're done, send me a concise shortlist containing the NYT article URL, the one practical anchor gift, the three Etsy ornaments, the two Duke Cannon gifts, and the three Lookfantastic gift-set options, including names, prices (when shown), and URLs for all of them.
